verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: satigur teerath chhadd kai aThisaTh teerath naavan jaahee|

en.bdb: Leaving aside pilgrimage centre in the form of the true Guru (God) people go to take bath at the sixty-eight holy places.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਜੰਤਾਂ ਘੁਟਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਖਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: bagul samaadh lagai kai jiau jal ja(n)taa(n) ghuT ghuT khaahee|

en.bdb: Like crane, they keep their eyes closed in trance but they catch hold of small creatures, press them hard and eat them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਨੀਰਿ ਨਵਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਖੇਹ ਉਡਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: hasatee neer navaaleean baahar nikal kheh uddaahee|

en.bdb: Elephant is given bath in water, but coming out of water it again spreads dust on its body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀ ਨ ਡੁਬੈ ਤੂੰਬੜੀ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: nadhee na ddubai too(n)baRee teerath vis nivaarai naahee|

en.bdb: Colocynth does not drown in water and even baths at many pilgrimage centres do not let its poison go.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰੁ ਨੀਰ ਪਖਾਲੀਐ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਨ ਭਿਜੈ ਗਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: pathar neer pakhaaleeaai chit kaThor na bhijai gaahee|

en.bdb: Stone put and washed in water remains hard as before and water does not get inside it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੰਭਲਭੂਸੇ ਖਾਇ ਭਵਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh bharam na utarai bha(n)bhalabhoose khai bhavaahee|

en.bdb: The illusions and doubts of the mind orientated, manmukh, never come to an end and he always wanders in dubiety.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਹੀ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: gur poore vin paar na paahee ||10||

en.bdb: Without the perfect Guru none can go across the world-ocean.
